releases.title: Whole chords strike again
notes: RETRIG has a new setting, Chord: the whole chord starts again, gliding from the last one.
Glide on VA sounds now takes the time you set.
The Lock layouts show a padlock in the top bar.

releases.title: The first release
notes: The lower keys play the notes of your scale; hold an upper key, and each note becomes a chord.
A bass part, an arpeggiator with a strum, a looper and about 60 VA and FM sounds.
A flower (Top layout) or a coral (Side layout) grows from every chord.
